spatial_filtering_rules.station_rule: Raw payload is preserved immutably in data/raw/. During normalization to interim/processed stages, records must match valid station_id (2178) and coordinates must fall strictly within Hanoi bounding box; out-of-bounds records are filtered.
spatial_filtering_rules.grid_rule: Query coordinates set to Hanoi urban core (21.0285N, 105.8542E); matched ERA5 cell (21.0545N, 105.8985E) is within 8.7km of station in urban Hanoi.
spatial_filtering_rules.airport_rule: Station 48820 (Noi Bai Airport) is within Hanoi administrative boundary but ~22km north of urban core; flagged as Weather Fallback with microclimate caveat.

data_quality_rules.pm25_negative_rule: Values < 0 µg/m³ are physically invalid and converted to NaN; observed values == 0.0 µg/m³ are retained if valid without station QC error flags; disguised missing markers (-999, -9999) are converted to NaN.
data_quality_rules.silent_zero_imputation: STRICTLY PROHIBITED; missing values are explicitly preserved as NaN.
data_quality_rules.openaq_data_level: Hourly aggregated data (/hours or S3 hourly archives), NOT raw instantaneous measurements.

pam_air_portal.provider: D&L Technology Integration and Consulting JSC
pam_air_portal.coverage: Multiple IoT sensor locations across Hanoi
pam_air_portal.access_limitations: Closed proprietary API (api.pamair.org requires partner token); no public bulk raw historical data download endpoint; GUI access only.
pam_air_portal.technical_limitations: Susceptible to uncalibrated baseline drift and severe humidity over-reporting (RH > 90%) without reference calibration nodes.

kaggle_community_datasets.coverage: Hanoi aggregated air quality and weather files
kaggle_community_datasets.access_limitations: Non-standardized multi-file community uploads; requires individual Kaggle account credentials for API download.
kaggle_community_datasets.technical_limitations: High data leakage risk due to opaque third-party preprocessing and imputation; lack of verifiable sensor hardware provenance (no FEM/FRM certification, no inlet height); apparent 0% missingness reflects artificial imputation rather than natural observations.
kaggle_community_datasets.recommended_use: External distribution check only; strictly prohibited as primary ingestion source.
